title: Picks settle on the 90-minute market
items: Draw picks now grade correctly: a knockout game level after regulation counts as a DRAW for the pick — extra time and penalties decide who advances, not the 1X2 result. This matches how the betting market your model predicts against actually settles.
Past picks graded under the old rule are automatically corrected on the next fetch (the diagnostics list each regrade).
Beat the Model picks follow the same convention.
Scorelines still display the full story: final score plus the shootout tag.
